Question 2
?

Consider the circle of radius 12 centered at the origin, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for θ∈[0,2π), traverse the circle once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point A(12,0)?

a
x=23cos⁡θ,y=23sin⁡θ
b
x=24cos⁡θ,y=24sin⁡θ
c
x=12cos⁡θ,y=12sin⁡θ
d
x=12sin⁡θ,y=12cos⁡θ
e
x=23sin⁡θ,y=23cos⁡θ
